title: StructSynth: Dependency Graphs as Generation Plans for Low-Data Tabular Synthesis with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2508.02601v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tabular data derives its value from inter-feature dependencies, yet preserving them during synthesis is fragile when samples are scarce. Existing approaches either learn dependencies implicitly through distribution fitting, rely on statistical graph learning that becomes unstable with few samples, or encode structure through flat text serialization. Recent graph-aware methods use dependency graphs as attention biases or as backbones for non-LLM samplers, but they do not use the graph as a prompt-level plan for organizing the LLM's own generation process. We introduce StructSynth, a framework that treats a dependency graph as a generation plan---determining the generation order, conditioning context, and scope of each black-box LLM call. In Evidence-Grounded Graph Induction, LLM reasoning and statistical association cues jointly construct a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) from limited samples. In Graph-Planned Conditional Synthesis

translated_title: StructSynth：将依赖图作为语言模型低数据表格合成的生成计划
translated_abstract: 表格数据的价值源于特征之间的依赖关系，然而在样本稀缺的情况下，合成过程中保留这些依赖关系十分脆弱。现有方法要么通过分布拟合隐式地学习依赖关系，要么依赖在样本稀少时变得不稳定的统计图学习，要么通过扁平的文本序列化来编码结构。最近的图感知方法将依赖图用作注意力偏置或非LLM采样器的骨架，但它们并未将图作为提示层面的计划来组织LLM自身的生成过程。我们提出StructSynth，一个将依赖图视为生成计划的框架——由它决定每个黑盒LLM调用的生成顺序、条件上下文和生成范围。在证据接地图归纳中，LLM推理与统计关联线索共同从有限样本中构建有向无环图（DAG）。在图规划条件合成中
tldr: StructSynth将依赖图作为生成计划来编排黑盒LLM的逐步生成过程，从而在低样本表格数据合成中有效保留特征间的依赖关系。
en_tdlr: StructSynth treats a dependency graph as a generation plan that orchestrates black-box LLM calls, preserving inter-feature dependencies in low-data tabular synthesis.
